result.description: Compact fictional tabletop audio mixer designed for small studios, podcast setups, and live instrument blending. Features 14 input channels, dual stereo buses, 3-band EQ per mono channel, and USB-C class-compliant recording output. Intended for creators who want hands-on control in a desktop format, with metal chassis, low-noise preamps, and a simple one-knob compressor on the first four mic inputs.
result.title: Aster Vale 14-Slot Analog Mixer
